annotations.title: Hash a Lean project at one commit

description: Compute the lean-bundle-sha256/v1 hash of a local Lean project at one git commit: SHA-256 over the root lean-toolchain, the root lake-manifest.json and every .lean file in that commit, read from committed git objects only. Returns commitRef, contentHash and hashAlgorithm to pass unchanged to papex_propose_record_artifact, plus file, byte and skipped-submodule counts. Runs on this computer and sends nothing to Papex. The hash fixes which files the commit holds; it does not show that the proof compiles or that it matches a claim.

ref.description: A commit id, branch or tag; defaults to HEAD. Only committed files count: the working tree, the index and .lake/ never change the hash.

repoPath.description: The top folder of a local git repository holding a Lean project. Its absolute path is never returned or sent to Papex. Refused: the filesystem root, the home folder itself, credential or system folders (such as ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.config, ~/Library, /etc), and, when PAPEX_UPLOAD_DIRS is set, any folder outside it.

name: papex_hash_lean_bundle
